notes.title: Autumn 2018 Patch
notes.content:
Hello, runaway train players.

We would like to announce that we just released another patch. In this patch, we focused on building and rail optimization. Besides that, we finally added support for ultra wide monitors (21:9) and GUI improvements for taller monitors (4:3 or 5:4). Others resolution use GUI for 16:9 which should not cause any issues anymore.

notes.title: Summer 2018 Patch
notes.content:
[h1] Train was under general maintaince[/h1]

- we have changed oil, replaced broken parts and installed some improvements.


We have massively improved performance, so now it should run smooth even on older devices. On the other hand size of the game grew from 70MB to 250MB... but we believe it will not be a huge problem. We also took a look on achievements which were very hard to obtain, to make them more feasible. Also fixed the case, when you connect all cities, the game will end. Also achievements should show progress on steam.

Hope you will like it.
